title: When and How Should an Agent Clarify? CIGAsk: Teaching LLMs to Clarify via Counterfactual Information Gain

rs.key_step: when由GT歧义标签非对称terminalbonus控制，how由冻结reference对有/无用户回复的GT loglikelihood差控制，两路分别归一。
rs.why_non_obvious: 局部澄清信息与是否发起澄清拆开；冻结proxy稳定却不等于当前策略真实actionvalue。
rs.trigger_condition: When asking and question informativeness require different supervision, separate ambiguity-based initiation credit from response-ablation information credit.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When asking and question informativeness require different supervision, separate ambiguity-based initiation credit from response-ablation information credit.

signatures.information: GT answer与ambiguity训练标签、real clarification reply、frozenreference、oracleintent simulator
signatures.operation: 固定同questionaction消融reply算logratio；terminal与intrinsic分开zscore后相加
signatures.failure_boundary: clearquery仍26%澄清；oracleintent cooperative simulator限制外推；AbgCoQA为重训迁移非零样本。

relevance.how: frozenreference loglikelihood gain不能直接当当前policy crop收益。
局部reward乘alpha后独立std可能抵消alpha。
when/how分离可改必要性gate，但GT歧义不总可得。
